candidate.trigger: Drag a navigation item horizontally, release outside the bar, then make a fresh pointer click on Overview.
candidate.pathToEffect: The outside mouseup preserves click suppression, which can carry into the next pointer gesture.
candidate.impact: The fresh Overview click emits no selection request.
